message: Editorial priority atlas 'Dónde se cruzan el agua y la necesidad' ready. 3D AGEB towers = people exposed (IMEPLAN share × population; or sim-drenaje exposed; or population), bivariate colour P×V, top-25 list with per-factor small multiples, municipality filter, '¿Por qué aquí?' breakdown, reweightable index Prioridad = 100·P^a·E^b·V^c shown in full. Modeled joins plug in automatically: sim-drenaje (flood_frequency, read live), sim-relieve (susc_mean), sim-hidro (share ≥15 cm Tr10, joined by invertir-1 into data/ageb-hidro.json). INEGI INV storm-inlet factor active. ?demo=1 = 25 s, window.__cauceDemo {duration_s:25, seek(t), play(), pause()}. Desktop 1600x1000 and phone 390x844 checked on W10; no console errors.
